meta.title: Studio — KB Labs
meta.description: The web UI layer of KB Labs. Plugins declare their pages and navigation; Studio renders everything in one place.

analytics.title: Track every token. Attribute every cost.
analytics.description: Provider breakdowns, model comparisons, latency histograms, and per-plugin spend — all in one view. No third-party analytics required.

pluginPages.title: Each plugin brings its own pages.
pluginPages.description: Install a plugin and its UI appears in the sidebar automatically. Plugins declare their own routes; Studio assembles the interface.

cta.title: Studio ships with the platform.
cta.description: One install command, one launch command. Studio is included — no separate setup, no extra config.

observability.title: Live logs. Real-time traces.
observability.description: Every workflow run, agent call, and plugin event captured in real time. Stream logs as they happen, filter by plugin or severity, export traces for post-mortem.

hero.title: One shell. Every plugin.
hero.description: Studio is the UI surface of KB Labs. Install a plugin — it appears in the sidebar. Plugins declare their own pages and nav items; Studio assembles them into a single interface without any extra wiring.
